explanation: Generator tripping is required if bus or GSU voltages fall below minimum steady-state or ride-through voltage limits to prevent cascading failures.
Transmission elements must be disconnected if relay loadability limits are exceeded to prevent instability and cascading failures.
Internal breaker faults require immediate protection action on both sides to clear the system fault.

condition: re_dispatch_required AND facilities_within_ratings AND NOT non_consequential_load_loss
explanation: Curtailment of Firm Transmission Service is allowed through re-dispatch if facilities remain within ratings and no non-consequential load loss occurs.
A single protective relay without an alternative may fail to clear faults within required times, risking equipment damage or safety hazards.

condition: communications_system_count == 1 AND (monitored_at_control_center == false OR reported_at_control_center == false)
explanation: A single unmonitored or unreported communications system may fail to support required protection schemes, delaying fault clearance.

condition: dc_supply_count == 1 AND (monitored_at_control_center == false OR reported_at_control_center == false)
explanation: A single unmonitored or unreported DC supply may fail to provide reliable power for protective functions, risking system instability.

condition: control_circuitry_count == 1 AND (trip_coil_monitored == false OR trip_coil_reported == false)
explanation: A single control circuitry without monitored trip coils may fail to execute protection actions, increasing fault duration and damage risk.

source: TPL-001-5.1 — Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements
explanation: Non-Consequential Load Loss is allowed if the Contingency voltage level exceeds 300 kV.

source: TPL-001-5.1 — Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements
explanation: Non-Consequential Load Loss is allowed if the planned loss is at least 25 MW.
